status_reviews.researcher_notes: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook (28 releases, May 2018–Aug 2026) shows project status as 'Applied' through October 2022 release, then 'Cancelled' in all releases from January 2023 onward. GEM last updated the sheet for this row in October 2022 (updated=2022-10-06), before the cancellation was reflected in EIA data. FERC CP19-193 docket for the Mainline 100/200 Replacement Project is the source authority; the certificate was not granted and the project was formally withdrawn effective 2023-01. This is a confirmed status change, not an inferred dormancy.
